repos_data.description: The Open Context Layer for Data and AI ,  OpenMetadata is the open platform for building trusted data context and business semantics for humans, AI assistants, and agents.
Cleanlab's open-source library is the standard data-centric AI package for data quality and machine learning with messy, real-world data and labels.

Desbordante is a high-performance data profiler that is capable of discovering many different patterns in data using various algorithms. It also allows to run data cleaning scenarios using these algorithms. Desbordante has a console version and an easy-to-use web application.
MCP server that profiles tabular data files (CSV, Parquet, Excel, JSON) for LLM agents like Claude.
